Therefore I searched online for coaching classes & found so many options that I got confused. I lost 1 week in deciding about class. Finally, I joined Englishnow after reading so many positive reviews on google & just dial. This proved to be a masterstroke in the end, as it helped me get my desired bands in 3 weeks only.
Englishnow is really the best choice for preparing for IELTS. It is located in central area of Dadar easily reachable from any place. Especially for me it was very convenient, as I live in Mahim. First of all, support staff is very helpful, especially Kritika who is always there to solve technical queries. Classrooms are small but well equipped with infrastructure. They have a well maintained computer library open for students from 8 am to 8 pm, where we can study grammar & vocabulary & also take practice tests. They run 3 batches for IELTS from Monday to Friday I.e. 8-9 am, 2-3 pm and 6-7 pm and have weekend Saturday batch from 4 to 8 pm. They allow you to have flexible timings as per your schedule, if you have less time left before exam like me. I attended daily evening and Saturday classes taught by Priya ma’am. I’m so impressed with her. She is an extraordinary teacher, passionate about teaching & dedicated to her students. She makes everyone feel comfortable in class & teaches in a friendly manner. She gives one on one attention to each n every student, identifies problem areas for each one of them & help overcome them by taking individual extra classes as needed. For example, she took extra speaking classes for me daily in the last week before exam, as I always felt nervous while speaking due to fear of making mistakes. The tricks & strategies taught by her are very helpful in finding answers in short time in all the sections. I met Sandeep sir on the day of my speaking test which was a day before my other 3 sections. He took my speaking mock test that afternoon. I was really feeling very nervous that day, despite preparing well for the exam. Sandeep sir sensed that & he gave us a short pep talk to boost our confidence. Those 10 minutes completely changed my mindset & I became relaxed n confident. I appeared for speaking test with confidence & really enjoyed it. It went smooth. I carried the positive mindset to the next day for the remaining 3 sections n did well. At the end of the test, I was sure of clearing it with the required bands.Today, I got my result & I did well as expected. My band score is as below:
Listening: 9.0
Reading: 9.0
Writing: 7.0
Speaking: 7.5
Overall: 8.0
Credit of my success entirely goes to Priya ma’am n her dedicated teaching. I just followed her instructions faithfully. I’m also really thankful to Sandeep sir for instilling confidence in me & entire Englishnow staff for their help. I thoroughly enjoyed my 3 weeks at this place & it was never boring to attend these classes. All in all, this is the best place to prepare for your IELTS or any other English language test without any doubt. Join in & enjoy the journey :)
